_help: Short paragraph under the newsletter header, labelled WEBSITE UPDATE: the due entries' text each as its own short paragraph in order of from date, then key, the last followed by one 'Have a look at harvingtonvillage.org.uk.' link (render.js). So write each text as one or two plain sentences that read well beside the others (check the other due entries so none repeats another): no 'New on the website:' and no 'Have a look'. Each entry: key (unique, letters/numbers/hyphens, never reused), from (first issue date it can appear, YYYY-MM-DD), optional until (last date), text, link (kept for the record; not shown). Shown in one issue that is sent live, then retired automatically.

entries.text: Planning applications, decisions and appeals for Harvington and Norton and Lenchwick now appear in the newsletter each week, and the last eight weeks are on our new Planning page.
harvingtonvillage.org.uk is the new website for Harvington, Norton and Lenchwick: what's on, local news, bins, church services and more.
